note: Task 8 (model orchestration). Atlas has NO model in its runtime today (tests/architecture/test_runtime_has_no_ai_provider_dependency.py). This file fixes the contract any future model must satisfy; AI-001 decides when one is added.

routing_policy.architecture_or_audit: strongest model; audit must use a model/session independent of the author
routing_policy.trading_decision: NONE: no model output is a trading decision

confidence_rule: a model's self-reported confidence is never Atlas confidence; only historically calibrated evidence can inform it
disagreement_rule: model A vs model B disagreement is recorded as DISAGREEMENT, never forced into consensus
failure_rule: timeout / malformed / unavailable / rate-limited / contradictory -> ABSTAIN; never a default action
